name: Share Samadhan Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, Share Samadhan Limited offers a wide range of services aimed at helping clients protect and recover their investments/money efficiently.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Service[1]
Investment Retrieval Services offers advisory solutions to help investors unlock value and resolve issues related to financial assets like equities, mutual funds, debentures, bonds, insurance, provident funds, etc. The company also assists in recovering unclaimed dividends, interest, and resolving problems with old or lost financial instruments such as physical shares and old insurance/PF securities, including handling transfers and transmissions.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 218 days.
Working capital days have increased from 162 days to 261 days
